tasks.title: Conversation #100
tasks.transcript:
Man: Are you ready for the charity run this weekend?
Woman: I think so. I've been training for the race this past month.
Man: That's great. Remember to drink water and pace yourself.
Woman: Thanks for the tips. Have you run in this event before?
Man: Yes, last year. It was a lot of fun. And the atmosphere was amazing.
Woman: I'm excited. I hope to beat my personal best time.

questions.stem: What event are the speakers discussing?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者在讨论什么活动？ 定位原文：Man: Are you ready for the charity run this weekend? 选项分析： A. A concert 音乐会。对话中未提及音乐，所以A选项错误。 B. A race 一场赛跑。男士明确提到“charity run”（慈善跑），女士也提到“training for the race”，所以B选项正确。 C. A work luncheon 工作午餐会。对话中未提及工作或午餐，所以C选项错误。 D. A birthday party 生日派对。对话中未提及生日，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What advice does the man give the woman?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：男士给了女士什么建议？ 定位原文：Man: Remember to drink water and pace yourself. 选项分析： A. Arrive early 早点到。对话中未提及到达时间，所以A选项错误。 B. Invite others 邀请其他人。对话中未提及邀请他人，所以B选项错误。 C. Drink water 喝水。男士明确提醒要喝水并控制节奏，所以C选项正确。 D. Bring some food 带些食物。对话中未提及食物，所以D选项错误。
